summary: Backend QA pass on the newly added native email/password auth on DEQUAD. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_email_auth.py covering 12 cases across /api/auth/register, /api/auth/email-login, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/logout, plus regression on /api/auth/admin-login. All 12 tests PASSED against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 on resource creation; conventional REST would use 201. Not breaking, but worth aligning.
Passwords are hashed with plain SHA-256 (no salt, no bcrypt/argon2). Acceptable in beta but MUST be migrated to bcrypt/argon2 before public launch — same applies to admin_password.
Email format check is very lax ('@' and a dot in domain). Things like 'a@b.c' or 'foo@bar.x' pass. Consider Pydantic EmailStr / proper regex before tightening to .ac.uk.

Pre-existing seeded users that only have admin_password (no password_hash) cannot use email-login — they get 401. Expected for now but flag it: any user created via /auth/session (Google) also has no password_hash, so they cannot fall back to email-login unless they go through /auth/register (which will 409). Consider an explicit 'set password' flow later.

action_items: Plan migration of password hashing from SHA-256 to bcrypt/argon2 before public launch.
Optionally return 201 from /api/auth/register and use Pydantic EmailStr for stricter email validation.
Decide UX for Google-created users who later want password-only login (today /auth/register 409s on their email).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: /auth/register and /auth/email-login both rotate sessions by `delete_many({user_id})` then insert — good (prevents stale tokens) and matches /auth/session behaviour.
auth.py: response.set_cookie uses secure=True, samesite='none', httponly=True — correct for the cross-site preview URL setup.
auth.py: _id is properly stripped from the user payload in both register (pop) and email-login (projection {_id:0}).
auth.py: /auth/email-login uses identical 'Invalid email or password.' message for both 'user not found' and 'wrong password' — correctly avoids account-existence leak.
helpers/auth.py: get_session_token correctly prefers Authorization header → query param → cookie; verified end-to-end via bearer-only requests.
Security: SHA-256 password hashing without salt is the single biggest risk in this module.
test_credentials: Admin: quadri.yusuf@dequad.com / Oluwatobi11@ verified. Dynamic e2e users created with timestamped emails (e2e_test_<ts>@example.com / Test12345!).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 2 transient users in the `users` collection (prefixed TEST_ or e2e_test_). No cleanup performed — main agent may want to add a periodic purge of e2e_test_/TEST_ emails.
